paragraphs.source_en:
In the spring we spent a week or two near Leghorn, borrowing the house of some
friends, who were absent on a journey to England. — It was on a beautiful summer
evening, while wandering among the lanes, whose myrtle hedges were the bowers of
the fire-flies, that we heard the carolling of the sky-lark, which inspired one of the most
beautiful of his poems.

beautiful of his poems.
